review_description: A family business with an absolute passion for solar. Clean, tidy, on time, great install, superb service and a pleasure to deal with. Stefan is the salesman and installer so you know what you’re going to get from the start - no contractors. I probably spoke to Stefan for a couple of hours discussing solar options before settling on a solar solution. Would highly recommend!

Stefan is well organised and professional and has delivered an install of the absolute highest quality for a fantastic price. If you want cheap and nasty, go elsewhere, there are plenty of those around, but if you are looking for high-quality value for money design and installation, then you can't go wrong with Stefan's Electrical. He also does off-grid installations which are exceptionally hard to find.
Organised, great price, great quality of work and up front and honest
